messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH  ironfield-prod (ironfield-reserve-v2). Symptoms: sporadic token truncation, increased 4xx and MODEL_TOO_LARGE errors, p99 token latency jump. Alert at 03:07 UTC. https://pager.redwood/incident/3100127890 :rotating_light:

riley_oncall: oncall acked. beginning triage. arjun, leah  can you check model variant diffs and cache eviction logs?

arjun_sre: looking. Observed sudden growth in KV cache entries and fragmented mem on gpu-5 starting 03:04:12. Several requests hit `MODEL_TOO_LARGE` after token expansion. Interesting: recent traffic shows more long-context requests from ironfield between 02:50-03:05. Also a new quantization patch deployed to `reserve-v2` at 02:58. Logs: ```
2026-03-16T03:04:12Z gpu-5 kv_entries=123456 kv_evictions=120
2026-03-16T03:05:01Z deploy: quant-variant qv2.0 applied to reserve-v2
2026-03-16T03:06:05Z request=tx_9a model_err=MODEL_TOO_LARGE tokens_sent=4096 status=413
```

leah_eng: if kv cache growth and memory fragmentation are the issue, we should avoid full pool recycle. Propose: (1) pin ironfield route to previous stable quant variant `redwood/llm-qv1.9` (2) set cache-policy to `soft-evict` with max_kv_entries=50k (3) enable regional spill to `us-west-hosted-fallback` for overflow limited to 20rps.

riley_oncall: agree. I'll run pins and cache change, then enable spill. Doing pin first. Command: ```
# pin model for ironfield
redwood routes pin --tenant ironfield-prod --model redwood/llm-qv1.9 --reason "mitigate qv2.0 memory fragmentation" --immediate
```

ops-sre-bot: ACTION: pin applied by riley_oncall at 03:15 UTC  audit=ao-3100127890-1

arjun_sre: verifying kernel state. After pin, no further MODEL_TOO_LARGE in last 60s on gpu-5. However kv entries still high. Applying cache policy: ```
redwood cache update --pool ironfield-reserve-v2 --policy soft-evict --max-kv-entries 50000
```

ops-sre-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: cache policy updated  change_id=cf-3100127890-2

hannah_se: I notified Ironfield ops (ironfield-infra slack) at 03:18 UTC with mitigation steps and recommended client-side short-circuit: cap client tokens to 2048 for 10 minutes. They asked if we can offer an immediate hosted fallback to prevent 413s; requesting hosted fallback gated by egress approval.

leah_eng: enabling regional hosted spill now with egress tag `ironfield-temp-egress` and rate limit 20rps. Config: ```
spill_policy:
  on_overflow: host_fallback
  host_fallback:
    allowed: true
    region: us-west-hosted-fallback
    max_rps: 20
    egress_tags: ["ironfield-temp-egress"]
```

ops-sre-bot: ACTION: hosted spill enabled  audit=ao-3100127890-3

triage-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 latency reduced from 1.9s -> 480ms for pinned route; MODEL_TOO_LARGE error rate decreased by 95% in first 3m after mitigation.

marta_cust_success: I sent customer status at 03:22 UTC: brief note + ask to cap retries and tokens. Ironfield replied: "appreciate quick fix, please confirm when full revert is safe".

arjun_sre: next steps for stabilization: schedule a controlled revert of autoscaler tweak that allowed dense placement with low compaction windows; add safety gate in autoscaler to refuse new placements if gpu free contiguous mem < 1GiB. Also need to roll quant-variant qv2.0 back to staging until fragmentation tests pass.

leah_eng: creating follow-up ticket PROD-12500  "ironfield: quant qv2.0 -> kv fragmentation; pin+spill mitigation; autoscaler safety gate" assigned to infra + runtime teams.

riley_oncall: timeline for incident: 03:07 alert -> 03:15 pin applied -> 03:17 cache policy changed -> 03:18 hosted spill enabled -> 03:20 observed drop in 413/4xx -> 03:25 monitoring window good. Downgrading pager.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: severity downgraded to MEDIUM at 03:27 UTC; monitor 45m. Incident ID: INC-2026-3100127890

arjun_sre: for postmortem include: kernel memory maps, NVML fragmentation stats, quantization kernel change log, and the autoscaler placement diff at 02:56-02:59. Also capture request-context (token counts) to reproduce.

hannah_se: customer asked for an explicit "no model weight changes" statement. I'll include in message. Also asked if we can expose a reversible `request-unpin` workflow for customers to start a supervised unpin request.

leah_eng: we'll add `--request-unpin` CLI that creates a ticket requiring ops approval and logs in audit. Low-friction but gated.

riley_oncall: handing off to oncall devs for root cause and patching. arjun + leah owners. I'll remain on cc. Marking thread tag `incident:ironfield-quant-frag` and closing paging.

ops-sre-bot: HANDOFF: paging -> dev-team at 03:33 UTC  handoff_id=ho-3100127890-4

marta_cust_success: customer acknowledged; requested ETA for revert. I promised 24h postmortem + next steps.

riley_oncall: closing paging thread. Please continue coordination in PROD-12500 or this thread if customer outreach required.
